Subject: Security & compliance architecture review — SOC 2 evidence and SSO

Hi Jamie,

Thanks for the interest in a technical deep-dive — really looking forward to walking through our architecture and alignment for SOC 2 evidence and the items on your checklist. To make the session most useful, we propose a 45-minute architecture review focused on:
- High-level architecture and data flows (network boundaries, data classification)
- Encryption at-rest and in-transit (key management options, KMS/HSM integrations)
- Audit logging and retention (what we log, how to access/export logs)
- SSO/SCIM and identity flows (IdP integrations, session lifetime)
- SOC 2 evidence mapping / next steps for evidence collection

Attached is a brief SOC2 readiness summary and our standard evidence list — happy to tailor before the call if you have specific controls you want addressed.

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Wed Jun 24, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Jun 25, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Fri Jun 26, 08:30–09:15 PT

If none of those work, please share a couple of windows that do and we can adjust. Lauren (cc'd) will send the calendar invite once we lock a time.

Attachments: SOC2_readiness_summary.pdf

Best,
